ROOT.viewdef: CREATE VIEW CDN.KntUpusty AS SELECT KPR_KntTyp AS KnU_KntTyp , KPR_KntFirma AS KnU_KntFirma , KPR_KntNumer AS KnU_KntNumer , TPR_LP AS KnU_KntLp --!!! , TPR_TwrTyp AS KnU_TwgTyp , TPR_TwrFirma AS KnU_TwgFirma , TPR_TwrNumer AS KnU_TwgNumer , TPR_TwrLp AS KnU_TwgLp , TPR_Wartosc AS KnU_Upust , cast('' as varchar(254)) AS KnU_UpustWzor , TPR_Waluta AS KnU_Symbol , cast(0 as smallint) AS KnU_NrKursu , TPR_FlagaNb AS KnU_FlagaNB , TPR_Notatki AS KnU_Notatki , TPR_ID AS KnU_TPRID , TPR_Typ AS KnU_Typ FROM cdn.TwrPromocje INNER JOIN Cdn.PrmKarty ON TPR_PrmId = Prm_Id INNER JOIN cdn.KntPromocje ON KPR_PrmId = PRM_Id WHERE PRM_Typ = 4

CREATE VIEW CDN.TwrUpusty AS SELECT TPR_TwrTyp AS TwU_TwrTyp , TPR_TwrFirma AS TwU_TwrFirma , TPR_TwrNumer AS TwU_TwrNumer , TPR_TwrLp AS TwU_TwrLp , TPR_Prog AS TwU_PRog , TPR_Wartosc AS TwU_Upust FROM cdn.TwrPromocje INNER JOIN Cdn.PrmKarty ON TPR_PrmId = PRM_Id WHERE PRM_Typ = 3
